patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patch from the link below Move the downloaded 'Game.rgssad' file into the game install folder mentioned above, overwriting the existing file when prompted. It's working if: The Photoalbum Page 1 art does not have censored nipples. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
